title: Design: COD row menu with no customers shows one greyed item
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • No customer other than the Counter Sale customer is on COD.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-06-row-menu-cod-the-default.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the COD row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a narrow menu opens with one item, "Move Customers" (person icon), greyed.
  • Step 2: a dark grey box opens to the left of the menu reading "No customers are on this term" (as in ct-p1-06-row-menu-cod-the-default.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S1-N3: “Every row has a "⋯" menu, because "Move Customers" appears on every row for every user who can open the page (S2-R1), greyed when it cannot be used. Credit Hold and the default COD row therefore always have a menu.”
  • S2-N2: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold never show "Deactivate" (S1-R9 explains why on the lock icon).”
  • S4-N2: “If no customer is on the term, "Move Customers" shows greyed with the hover text "No customers are on this term".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a blocked Move Customers | "No customers are on this term" | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Row menu: COD, the default"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-06-row-menu-cod-the-default.png

The design's own words:

  • “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold never show Deactivate; the default never shows Make Default. The menu is 158px, as wide as its one item.”
